subject: Midterm renewal: onboarding refresh + capacity increase plan
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@enterpriseacme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@enterpriseacme.com
Date: 2029-08-01T15:22:00Z
Subject: Midterm renewal: onboarding refresh + capacity increase plan

Hi Vivek,

We're getting our renewal calendar in order and want to align on two items: a short vendor onboarding refresh (procurement wants a clean evidence bundle in the portal) and a capacity increase for Q4. High level: 

- Current term ends 2029-12-31; we are targeting a 12-month renewal with an immediate +20% committed capacity bump effective 2029-10-01.
- Procurement needs a vendor onboarding refresh packet (updated contact, attestation, SOC2 summary) and a single ZIP evidence bundle uploaded to the portal for review.

Can you confirm Redwood can: 1) provide a consolidated evidence bundle suitable for upload, 2) accept a PO net-30, and 3) share a suggested timeline for onboarding + capacity ramp?

I've attached our procurement intake checklist and a template the portal prefers.

Attachments: EA_procurement_requirements_v1.pdf (PDF), onboarding-template.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Procurement Lead, Enterprise Acme
ellen.park@enterpriseacme.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@enterpriseacme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-08-01T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Midterm renewal: onboarding refresh + capacity increase plan

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can produce a consolidated evidence bundle; yes, we accept PO net-30 (standard); and we can run a staged capacity ramp to hit +20% by 2029-10-01 with a short onboarding refresh. Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):

1) This week (by 2029-08-05): Redwood compiles evidence bundle (SOC2 summary, data handling attestation, contact matrix).
2) 2029-08-06 to 2029-08-16: Upload to your procurement portal and remediation window for any follow-ups.
3) 2029-08-19 to 2029-09-15: CanR&D/ops validation and test traffic (small pilot).
4) 2029-10-01: Capacity bump to +20% live in production.

Actions: Marcus — I'll need you to pull the SOC2 extract and the operational runbook. Laura — can you draft the renewal SOW with the capacity addendum? Avery — will own the portal upload and DocuSign flow once we have the bundle.

I'll attach a short options memo that outlines pricing tiers for a 12-month renewal vs. an 18-month committed discount.

Attachments: redwood-renewal-options.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-08-02T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Midterm renewal: onboarding refresh + capacity increase plan

Vivek / team — quick notes from the trust & safety side:

- I can extract a 1-pager SOC2 summary and a short data retention policy excerpt by EOD 2029-08-03.
- We should confirm whether Enterprise Acme requires evidence signed by our external auditor or if a Redwood attestation is sufficient for the portal intake (their checklist sometimes insists on auditor signature).
- Lead time for provisioning the +20% depends on pool availability; ops will need a 72-hour lead after acceptance of SOW.

I'll prep SOC2-summary.pdf and a brief runbook snippet. Once Laura posts the SOW draft I'll review the acceptance & rollback clauses.

Marcus
Director, Reliability & Compliance
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@enterpriseacme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@enterpriseacme.com
Date: 2029-08-03T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Midterm renewal: onboarding refresh + capacity increase plan

Vivek — thanks, that MAP looks good. A couple of clarifications:

- Procurement prefers the evidence bundle as a single ZIP uploaded via our portal. I've created an invite you can use: https://procure.enterpriseacme.com/invite/4a9b2c (expires 2029-08-10).
- For auditor-signed docs: we only require the external auditor signature for new vendors or material scope changes. The capacity addendum alone should be fine with a Redwood attestation, but procurement may request the auditor summary during final review.
- Billing: please route PO to billing@enterpriseacme.com with PO reference R-ACME-7089. Net-30 standard is accepted.

I'll start the portal review as soon as the ZIP is uploaded.

Best,
Ellen
Procurement Lead, Enterprise Acme
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-08-04T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Midterm renewal: onboarding refresh + capacity increase plan

All — quick status and next steps.

- Draft SOW with capacity addendum attached (renewal-sow-draft.docx). Key callouts: effective date 2029-10-01, +20% committed tokens, pricing aligned to the 12-month tier with early-bird credit if PO received by 2029-08-20.
- Marcus: SOC2-summary.pdf is attached for upload; please add the retention excerpt.
- Avery: you'll coordinate portal upload and start the DocuSign envelope using the link below once the ZIP is ready.

Quoted for context:
> On 2029-08-03T13:45:00Z Ellen Park <ellen.park@enterpriseacme.com> wrote:
> Vivek — thanks, that MAP looks good. A couple of clarifications:...

DocuSign prep link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/RWD-ACME-2029-08

I'll merge the final edits by Friday and allocate the PO acceptance workflow.

Laura Bennett
